title: Isiphephelo
empty: Isiphephelo sakho asinalutho. Amanothi, izixhumanisi namafayela owafaka lapha abethelwe kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekugcineni futhi akulandela kuyo yonke idivayisi yakho.
saveFailed: Ayikwazanga ukulondoloza esiphephelweni sakho. Okusalungiswa kwakho kubuyele endaweni yokubhala.
saveFailedOffline: Ayikwazanga ukufinyelela i-Pollis ukuze ilondoloze lokhu. Okusalungiswa kwakho kubuyele endaweni yokubhala — hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.
saveFailedTooLarge: Ifayela elithile likhulu kakhulu esiphephelweni sakho. Okusalungiswa kwakho kubuyele endaweni yokubhala — lisuse bese uthumela futhi.

delete.heading: Susa okufakiwe
delete.body: Susa lokhu okufakiwe esiphephelweni sakho kuwo onke amadivayisi? Lokhu akukwazi ukuhlehliswa.

media.empty: Ayikabikho imidiya esiphephelweni sakho — faka izithombe noma amafayela ekubukeni kwengxoxo.
